# Check current state first
seg = current_frame.segmentation
red_items = []
green_items = []
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['pixels'] == 16 and node['color'] not in ['B', 'W', 'g']:
        boundary = node['boundary']
        center_r = sum(p[0] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
        center_c = sum(p[1] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
        if 20 <= center_r <= 25:
            red_items.append((center_c, node['color']))
        elif 34 <= center_r <= 40:
            green_items.append((center_c, node['color']))
red_items.sort()
green_items.sort()
print(f"Red: {red_items}")
print(f"Green: {green_items}")

# Try odd/even hypothesis:
# Red: orange, red, _, green (N)
# Green: purple, blue, yellow, pink
# Need to swap pink and yellow in green container
# Select pink (col 34) then click yellow (col 40)
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 35, 'col': 34}, {'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 35, 'col': 40}])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
